bmt-2022-calculus-tiebreaker-01.title: L'Hopital
bmt-2022-calculus-tiebreaker-01.body:
The limit is $\lim\frac{\int_1^n\ln x\,dx}{n\ln n}$, of type $\infty/\infty$. Differentiating numerator and denominator in $n$ gives $\frac{\ln n}{\ln n+1}\to1$.

**Answer: 1**

bmt-2022-calculus-tiebreaker-01.title: Evaluate the integral
bmt-2022-calculus-tiebreaker-01.body:
$\int_1^n\ln x\,dx=n\ln n-n+1$, so the ratio is $1-\frac{n-1}{n\ln n}\to1$.

**Answer: 1**

bmt-2022-calculus-tiebreaker-03.title: Symmetry
bmt-2022-calculus-tiebreaker-03.body:
Let $x=e^u$: $I=\int_{-1}^1\arctan(e^u)\,du$. Substituting $u\to-u$ gives also $I=\int_{-1}^1\arctan(e^{-u})\,du$. Adding and using $\arctan y+\arctan\frac1y=\frac\pi2$ for $y>0$: $2I=\int_{-1}^1\frac\pi2\,du=\pi$, so $I=\frac\pi2$.

**Answer: $\frac\pi2$**
